source.author: Peter Woit
source.title: Notes on the Twistor P1
source.source_statement: W05 presents a division representative (p,u)/Qp with u a nonsquare unit and gives the finite-prime conic -p*x^2-u*y^2+u*p*z^2=0 with no Qp-points; only the subsequent count of three quadratic extensions explicitly carries p != 2.
source.source_quantifier_fidelity: The paper does not explicitly say EVERY nonsquare unit u must give a division representative. This artifact falsifies that possible universal interpretation, not the existential existence of a division representative.

quaternion_algebra.conclusion: (2,7) over Q_2 is split M_2(Q_2) by explicit rational four-dimensional basis representation

conclusions.counterexample: u nonsquare alone DOES NOT suffice for p=2 division/conic-no-Qp-point conclusion.
conclusions.qualified_scope: At odd p, nonsquare unit u is the ordinary unramified nonsquare case; p=2 requires additional parameter/valuation tests. Neither statement upgrades the source claims to a universal theorem.
conclusions.preserves_source: Do not substitute these math conclusions for Woit's words; mark the universal interpretation falsified and require G0 adjudication before any promotion.
necessary_G0_follow_up: Qualify existential versus universal meaning of (p,u) representative and derived conic claims at W-SSC-105/106.
Retain p != 2 explicit source guard on three named quadratic extensions; do not infer it silently for other source sentences.
Independently audit source's asserted Gal(K/Qp) fixed-point-free claim under the actual division representative.
No change to frozen-source census or downstream modules until G0 requalification.
